tasks.title: Testing does this set the right status
New Project Wizard Page: (/projects/new) Feedback
tasks.description:
* Auto set end date for a project when creating. Overall in the creation process every filed should be set by default if the user does not set it.
    * when creating a project in the work breakdown stage:
        * have the new inputs be empty but be placeholders so the user can just start writing text
        * when you hit enter in an epic input have it create a new one
    * When Creating any long form we need a way to have the create button or top nav stick to the top. the example is creating Milestones and having to scroll to the top to create a new one. or having one at the top and the bottom
    * Create a way to have a custom Implementation framework where you can create the Stages and add default tasks that can be created across epic or just once.
        * Also add that functionality that you can edit and change the templated tasks before they get applied. or add some custom tasks. The templates need to be place holders.
    * Filter user select by the people who that role. This will require more work in templates and user management where they will need to do a mapping on what roles people can be assigned. maybe there is a table then a permission matrix that allows you to decide who can be assigned to that role.
    * When creating a project fix the notification that is triggered after something has been created (some times being hundreds of tasks)
